SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
Section 1, Special Branch............ *Adolphi*
REPORT
Date September 14, 1937

Subject Communication dated 7-9-37 from the Netherlands Consulate-General
concerning Miss N.S. Uchakina.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev    Forwarded by C. Crawford [签名]

Miss Nina Sergeevna UCHAKINA, Russian, was born
on January 20, 1911 at Harbin . She is reported to be the daughter
of a former employee of the Chinese Eastern Railway. According
to her own statement, she left Harbin for Hankow in 1932 and re-
sided in the latter city until 1935 working as a manicurist.
In summer 1935 she went to Chefoo where she resided at the
Beach Cafe and was employed as a dancing partner. In September
of the same year she arrived in Shanghai from Chefoo and has
since been residing in this city. She is reported to have worked
as a dancing partner at the Casanova Cabaret for some time.
On August 30, 1937 she registered at the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau, through the medium of the Russian Emi-
grants Committee, on the strength of Residential Permit No 348
issued on 9-9-35 by the Chefoo Police. At the same time
Miss Uchakina applied for a passport to enable her to proceed
to the Netherlands Indies in order, she stated, to join her
fiance. In conformity with the Provisional Regulations concern-
ing Registration, Passports, Visas and Certificates she was issued
by the S.M.P. Police Bureau with Travelling Certificate No 692
in lieu of passport for travelling to the Netherlands Indies.
Her last known address is 475 Route Cardinal Mercier.
Miss Uchakina's sister, A. Uchakina, reported to be a dancing
partner, resides at 453 Route Cardinal Mercier.
While in Shanghai Miss Uchakina did not come to the
notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any activities
of an undesirable character.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

D.C. ( Crime & Special Branches )

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____ 
第一科，特务科 ____  *Adolphi*（音译）
报告
日期：1937年9月14日

事由：荷兰总领事馆于1937年9月7日来函，涉及N.S. Uchakina小姐。

由特务科督察普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报    由C. Crawford转呈 [签名]

尼娜·谢尔盖耶芙娜·乌恰金娜（Nina Sergeevna UCHAKINA）小姐，俄国人，1911年1月20日出生于哈尔滨。据称她是前中东铁路雇员的女儿。据其自述，她于1932年离开哈尔滨前往汉口，并在那里居住至1935年，职业为美甲师。
1935年夏，她前往烟台，居住在“海滩咖啡馆”（Beach Cafe），受雇为舞伴。同年9月，她从烟台抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。据称她曾在卡萨诺瓦歌舞厅（Casanova Cabaret）担任舞伴一段时间。
1937年8月30日，她通过俄国侨民委员会，凭烟台警方于1935年9月9日签发的第348号居住证，在上海市政府警察局登记。同时，乌恰金娜小姐申请护照，以便前往荷属东印度，据称是为了与她的未婚夫团聚。根据《关于登记、护照、签证及证明书的暂行条例》，工部局警务处向她签发了第692号旅行证明书，以代替前往荷属东印度的护照。
她最后的已知地址是梅爱禄路（Route Cardinal Mercier）475号。
乌恰金娜小姐的姐姐A. Uchakina，据称为舞伴，居住在梅爱禄路453号。
乌恰金娜小姐在上海期间，未因任何不良行为引起工部局警方的注意。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特务科督察

副总监
（刑事及特务科）

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter No.2822 dated 3rd September, 1937,
and in reply, to inform you that there is nothing in
police records against Miss N. S. Uchakina, concerning
whom a copy of police report is appended herewith.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
